name: Ugly Dodo 38
author: AbanoubMagdy1
description: Neon rounded sky-blue toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from #eee to #2196F3, transform becomes translateX(3em), transform becomes translateX(3rem) translateY(-50%). On focus, box-shadow becomes 0 0 1px #2196F3.
